tools.description: Patch one/many files. Input requires *** Begin Patch and *** End Patch.
tools.name: apply_patch

input.description: Patch content using the *** Begin Patch/End Patch format.

tools.description: Call an exact Tool Search result id or name through OpenClaw.
tools.name: dispatch_action

id.description: Tool search result id or tool name.

tools.description: Exact single-file replacements. oldText unique/non-overlapping against original. Merge nearby changes; omit large unchanged spans.
tools.name: edit

edits.description: Targeted replacements against original file; no overlap/nesting. Merge nearby changes.

oldText.description: Exact original text; unique and non-overlapping in this call.

tools.description: Run shell and wait for completion. Omit host/node to use the session's configured host. TTY CLI/UI/coding agent: pty=true. Quote arguments containing shell metacharacters, including URL query strings with `?` or `&`.
tools.name: exec

ask.description: Requests stricter approvals under tools.exec.mode and host policy; channel-origin calls cannot override host ask=off.

awaitResults.description: Result required to finish the task; wait for terminal collection. Not for detached servers.

env.description: Literal overrides; no expansion. Omit to inherit.

host.description: Omit: named node or configured host (gateway). auto: configured host.

node.description: Node id/name; implies host=node if host is omitted. Other hosts conflict.

title.description: Every call: short purpose; never claim success. No secrets.

tools.description: Read text/image file (jpg/png/gif/webp/bmp); images attach to model context. Text caps 2000 lines or 50KB. Continue with offset/limit, or cursor within a long line.
tools.name: read

cursor.description: Character position within the start line; 0-based.

optional.description: Missing paths return structured not_found instead of failing.

tools.description: Load the full schema and metadata for one search result when its input is not already clear.
tools.name: tool_describe

id.description: Tool search result id or tool name.

tools.description: Search the effective Tool Search catalog. Pass query for one search or queries for several independent searches in one call; a non-empty query joins a non-empty batch first, with its own limit. Batch results stay grouped in request order. Queries must be in English: matching is lexical against tool names and descriptions, which are written in English, so another language will usually match nothing. Pass an exact result id or name to dispatch_action; use tool_describe only when you need its input schema.
tools.name: tool_search

limit.description: Maximum number of single-search results. Omitted or null uses the default. With only batch queries, omit this or set it to null; set limits on each batch entry.
Maximum results for this query. Defaults to 8 when omitted.

query.description: Search query, in English. Describe the capability you need.

queries.description: Independent searches. Prefer this alone for several searches; a non-empty query beside it runs as the first entry. Their effective limits may total at most 50; an omitted item limit counts as 8. The serialized query strings may use at most 512 UTF-8 bytes in total.

query.description: Single search query, in English. A non-empty query joins a non-empty batch first. Null or blank is ignored beside a non-empty batch.
